children: Block reached an agreement in principle to settle a federal securities class action for approximately $442.5 million, subject to court approval.
The proposed settlement requires preliminary and final court approval.
The action alleges Exchange Act violations and covers purchasers of Block Class A common stock from February 26, 2020, through August 1, 2024.
